name: Pull quote
summary: An oversized mark, the line in display type, and an attribution — testimonial or thesis.

slots.label: Kicker
slots.tooltip: A small coloured label above the quote, like the topic it belongs to

slots.label: Quote
slots.tooltip: The words being quoted, shown big in the middle of the slide

slots.label: Who said it
slots.tooltip: The name of the person (or kind of person) the quote comes from

slots.label: Their role
slots.tooltip: A small line under the name: their job, company or when they said it

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The accent colour of the quote mark, the kicker and the divider line

content.quote: The bottleneck was never typing code. It was deciding what to build — and now the machine waits on exactly that.
content.name: A working developer
